proposal.expected_benefit: This will help in identifying vulnerabilities and ensuring the system's defenses are effective against a broader range of threats, thereby improving overall security posture.
proposal.problem: The scenario lacks adversarial payloads or attack signals, which may lead to overconfidence in the system's security posture.
proposal.proposed_change: Introduce adversarial payloads or attack signals in future scenarios to simulate real-world threats and ensure the system's robustness against potential edge cases.
proposal.title: Enhance Scenario Diversity for Robustness
verification_tests: Evaluate system response to adversarial payloads in modified scenarios
Assess detection and mitigation capabilities against simulated attacks
